utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the old community center!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn, sorry I'm late—just caught wind of it! What time Saturday are we meeting up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's starting at 9 AM, so we'll have the whole day to work. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Dane, it's a chance for us to tackle some of those little fixes around the neighborhood—porch steps, fence posts, that sort of thing. We're settling on a regular morning time, if you're interested.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Eli, you've heard more than I have—I've just been picking up whispers from Quinn. A regular morning sounds like a good way to pull folks together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: How about we aim for 9 AM on Saturdays? That way folks can get a good start on the day's tasks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Kira, do you know what time the repair drive kicks off on Saturday? I need to work it around dropping the kids off at soccer.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is this repair drive actually happening? I've heard rumors, but nobody's given me a straight answer yet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's definitely happening. I've heard from a few people—they're fixing up the community center this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, a repair drive? I feel like someone mentioned it, but I can't remember if it's this weekend or next. Did you catch the date?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think Mr. Henson said something about it being soon, maybe this weekend? He mentioned we got some new tools in, welding gear too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Welding gear, huh? That reminds me—I think Vik was supposed to bring something for that. Did he confirm?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Vik, do we have any idea who's bringing what tools? I don't want to show up and find we're short on screwdrivers or something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm planning a repair drive this weekend—should be great once everyone gets on board! But I haven't sorted out the tool list yet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: So no tool list yet? That's exactly what I was worried about—how are we supposed to coordinate if we don't even know what we're working with?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Isn't it great they're finally sprucing up that old community center? I heard there's even going to be a bake sale to go with the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, a bake sale? I thought it was just a cleanup and basic fixes—do you know if there's a sign-up list or schedule somewhere?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think Mara mentioned a chalkboard out front with all the times and tasks—maybe pop by and check it out?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Oren, you joining the repair drive this weekend? I need a heavy-duty wrench if you've got one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I keep meaning to get organized for it. A heavy-duty wrench, you say? Let me check my garage—I might have one buried somewhere under all those old newspapers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, let me know soon—I've got to fix the community shed latch before it rains.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard something about a repair drive. Might swing by if I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Bo, it's this Saturday at the community center — Tess told me about it. Gus already has his toolkit ready, sounds like a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Saturday at the community center? Got it. I'll try to make it if my schedule clears up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Jules! Did you hear the repair drive's been switched to Sunday at the community center? I've been tracking the changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sunday at the community center — that's great to hear! I've been asking around, and everyone seems to want to help out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, and I just saw the repair truck head down Oak Street — hopefully they're getting set up early.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools ready. When are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Leo, there's been a change — we're now doing it Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday works. I'll bring the tools over in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center, if you haven't heard.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sunday, huh? I guess that gives me more time to think about whether to bring anything in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it's better this way—should be quieter, more space too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I've been hearing a lot about the repair drive this Saturday. Got any updates on how the planning is going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, Ira, I've got my tool kit ready if needed, but I haven't heard much more than you about the planning details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I've been hearing bits and pieces too. Hopefully it all comes together by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, need any tools for the repair drive? I've got plenty to lend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, thanks Gus! I'm really excited about the repair drive this weekend. I could definitely use your tools!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, just let me know what you need—I've got wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, you name it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard from Mr. Henson that new tools showed up, but I'm still trying to figure out how it all works.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: New tools? That's interesting. Did Mr. Henson mention what kind of tools they are?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: He just said they were new and shiny, like the kind you'd see in a hardware store catalog.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, tools are ready. When are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning, bright and early. Let's meet at the community center at 8.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, I'll be there at 8. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, what's the latest on the repair drive? Need a hand?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late—I'm still figuring out the details, but Eli mentioned we're settling on a morning check-in time. You should join us!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good! What time are we meeting up? I can bring some tools if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, are you thinking of helping out with that repair drive? I've been asking around and it seems like everyone's got a different take on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you've been asking around too? Who actually told you it's happening for sure?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Honestly, I've heard from Nell and Mara, but it's all bits and pieces—nobody's given me a solid confirmation yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive—right, this Saturday. I think I heard Marcus or Terrence mention the hardware store run, but honestly, I'm just trying to keep my head above water this week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sunday, huh? Well, I'll try to remember that. Thanks for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing up the old community center!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I've been picking up little bits from Quinn—sounds like the whole block's coming together for something big.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's gonna be wonderful! I heard we're painting the mural room and fixing that old stage—should be quite the shindig.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, have you got a heavy-duty wrench I could borrow for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wrench? Let me check—I think I've got one in the shed. I've been hearing Oren's organizing the whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: You've got one? Great. Could you bring it to the shed on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all getting together to fix up the old community center!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I keep meaning to get organized for it. Do you know what time we're starting on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I think it's starting at 9 AM, but let me double-check with Tess to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh hi Bo! We're organizing a neighborhood repair drive this Sunday at the community center to fix up shared tools and broken items. Would you like to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's right, Sunday at the community center. I'm glad we're getting organized, even if I need to rest today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great to have you both on board! We'll have refreshments and plenty of tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that sounds promising! Do we know exactly when the drive starts? I need to plan around the kids' school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's aim for 9 AM sharp. That way we can get a good start before the afternoon rush, and it should be clear of school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9 AM works perfectly for me — I can drop the kids off and head straight over.
